primary: terminal game-owned goal, survival, shortages and exact public logistics reachability
secondary: selected repairs/retained/fresh, actual deviations from a remembered head, common-branch fallbacks; specified before execution
matrix: 24 diagnostic and 192 confirmation paired executions; no post-outcome tuning
inference: descriptive fixed-condition comparisons; deterministic seed repetitions are not independent samples; no confidence claim
exploratory: actual action sequence equality added after diagnostic outcomes to explain whether patches affected execution; not an acceptance measure
